about: Advisories this project has read, judged and accepted for now, each with the reason and the date it must be looked at again. scripts/audit-gate.mjs fails on any advisory of moderate severity or worse that is not here, and on any entry here whose review_by date has passed. Add an entry only with a reason a reviewer can check; never to make the gate pass. docs/SECURITY-LAYERS.md, layer 1.

accepted.where: the Study Room's editor (@blocksuite/* 0.22.4), in the reader's own browser
accepted.why: Memory exhaustion while validating very large constrained collections. The editor validates its own document model, not data from other people, and the only fix is zod 4.6.6, which @blocksuite does not support yet; the only editor release without zod 3 is 0.20.0, which lacks features the Study Room uses. docs/SECURITY.md, October 2026.

accepted.where: the Study Room's editor (@blocksuite/* 0.22.4), in the reader's own browser
accepted.why: An existing prototype pollution can bypass KaTeX's trust setting. It needs a separate prototype-pollution flaw to exist first, and the editor renders the reader's own formulas. Fixed in KaTeX 0.18.2, which the editor pins below. docs/SECURITY.md, October 2026.

accepted.where: the Study Room's editor (@blocksuite/* 0.22.4), in the reader's own browser
accepted.why: A pattern built to amplify can make minimatch slow. The editor's only use is @blocksuite/store's schema check, matching one block type name against another from its own registered schema (affine:paragraph against affine:*); no member writes a pattern, and the worst case is one person's own editor slowing. Fixed only in minimatch 11.0.1, a major version the editor does not take, and npm's offered fix is a downgrade of the editor to 0.19.5. Review when the editor is updated.
